body.name: \Omega_{\zeta}
body.def: For design B, \(\Omega_{\zeta}=\operatorname{diag}(p^{-})-p^{-}p^{-\top}\). For design A with estimated margins, append the independent block \(\lambda\{\operatorname{diag}(m^{-})-m^{-}m^{-\top}\}\); omit that block for known margins.
body.role: asymptotic covariance of the reduced observable coordinates
